readme:
# Impressum Extractor - DACH Company Legal Notice, Register, VAT ID, Directors

Paste a list of company websites and get the legal notice (Impressum) of each one as structured data: company name, legal form, address, register court and number, VAT id, managing directors, responsible person, e-mail and phone. Built for Germany, Austria and Switzerland. One row per website, ready for lead generation, company data enrichment and KYC onboarding checks.

No login, no API key and no proxy setup required.

---

## Features

- One row per website, in input order, with a clear `status` for every site
- Legal identity: `company_name`, `legal_form` (GmbH, AG, KG, GmbH & Co. KG, UG, e.K., SE, eG, e.V., GesmbH, OG, Sàrl, SA, Sagl and more)
- Address split into `street`, `postal_code`, `city`, `country` (DE, AT, CH, LI) plus `full_address`
- People: `managing_directors`, `representatives` (name plus the role wording as published), `supervisory_board_chair`
- Register data: `register_court`, `register_type` (HRB, HRA, GnR, PR, VR, FN, ZVR, UID), `register_number`, and other register numbers named on the same page
- Tax data: `vat_id` (USt-IdNr, ATU, CHE MWST), `tax_number`, `share_capital`, and other VAT ids named on the same page
- Contact data: `emails` (protected and "(at)" spellings decoded), `phones` in E.164 format plus `phones_raw` as written, `fax`
- Responsibility and supervision: `responsible_for_content` (V.i.S.d.P., section 18 MStV), `publisher`, `supervisory_authority`, `chamber`, `professional_rules`, `business_purpose`
- `impressum_url` of the page the data came from, and the cleaned `impressum_text` (first 8,000 characters)
- German, English, French and Italian legal pages (Impressum, Imprint, Legal notice, Rechtliche Hinweise, Mentions légales, Note legali)
- Missing fields are `null` (single values) or `[]` (lists), so every row has the same shape
- Pay only for rows where the legal notice was found

---

## Sample input

```json
{
  "websites": ["bosch.de", "wienenergie.at"],
  "maxPagesPerSite": 3,
  "language": "auto",
  "maxResults": 100
}
```

Domains and URLs are both fine, with or without `https://` and `www`. Paths and tracking parameters are ignored, duplicates are removed. An e-mail address is reduced to its domain.

---

## Input fields

| Field | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `websites` | list of strings | bosch.de | Company websites, domains or URLs. One row per website. |
| `maxPagesPerSite` | integer 2-6 | 3 | Pages requested per website: the homepage, the legal page and fallback paths. |
| `language` | auto, de, en, fr, it | auto | Preferred language of the legal page. Auto follows the homepage language. |
| `maxResults` | integer | 100 | Maximum number of websites processed, which is the maximum number of rows. |
| `maxConcurrency` | integer 1-20 | 5 | Websites processed in parallel. |

### How the legal page is found

The actor reads the homepage and looks for a link labelled Impressum, Imprint, Legal notice, Rechtliche Hinweise, Rechtliches, Mentions légales, Note legali or Kontakt & Impressum, preferring links in the footer and links on the same site. If there is no such link it tries the common paths `/impressum`, `/imprint`, `/de/impressum`, `/legal` and `/legal-notice`. A privacy policy is not accepted as a legal notice.

## FAQ

**The homepage itself shows the register number or VAT ID, but there is no legal page. What do I get?**
A row with `status: ok` and `impressum_url` set to the homepage. `status_detail` says "legal data found on the homepage". The row is charged.

**The homepage and the legal page both return 403 or a block page. What do I get?**
A row with `status: not_reachable` (for example `http_403`). It is not charged.

**The homepage is blocked (403) but the legal page is open. What do I get?**
After a 401, 403, 429 or 5xx on the homepage the actor still tries the usual legal paths such as `/impressum` and `/service/impressum`. If one of them returns a legal notice, the row is `ok` and charged. A 404 on a guessed path never counts as a legal notice.

**The Impressum link is not a normal link in the page.**
Footers that ship their links as JSON (common on JavaScript sites) are read too.

## Status values

| `status` | Meaning | Charged |
|---|---|---|
| `ok` | The legal notice was found and read. | Yes |
| `no_impressum_found` | The site loaded, but no legal page was found within `maxPagesPerSite`. | No |
| `not_reachable` | The site or its legal page could not be read. | No |

`status_detail` explains every status other than `ok`: `http_403`, `http_404`, `js_required`, `bot_challenge`, `cookie_wall`, `consent_redirect`, `off_site_redirect`, `empty_response`, `timeout`, `dns_error`, `connection_failed`, `tls_error`, `legal_page_<reason> (url)` when the legal page itself could not be read, or `no legal page found (checked N pages)`.

## Pricing (Pay-per-event)

| Event | Description | When it fires |
|---|---|---|
| `impressum-result` | One website with a legal notice read | Once per row with `status: ok`, after the row is delivered |

Price: $0.001 per run start plus $0.003 per Impressum found ($3.00 per 1,000 results). Rows with `no_impressum_found` or `not_reachable` are free. The actor stops cleanly when your maximum total charge is reached.

---

## Limits

- Websites that only show their content after JavaScript runs come back as `not_reachable` with `js_required`. The actor does not run scripts.
- Cookie walls, consent pages and bot challenges are not clicked through or worked around. These sites come back as `not_reachable` (`cookie_wall`, `consent_redirect`, `bot_challenge`).
- Switzerland has no general Impressum duty. Many Swiss sites publish little or nothing, so expect more `no_impressum_found` rows and sparser fields there.
- Fields are read from the text of the notice. If a site leaves placeholders such as "[bitte ergänzen]", those fields stay `null`.
- Sites that publish several legal entities on one page return the first one in the main fields and the others in `additional_register_numbers` and `additional_vat_ids`.
- The data is what the website publishes. You are responsible for lawful use of personal data such as names, e-mail addresses and phone numbers (GDPR, UWG and national marketing rules).

## Use with AI agents (MCP)

This actor works with the Apify MCP server, so AI assistants can call it as a tool. Actor id: `nanoscrape/impressum-extractor`.

Endpoint: `https://mcp.apify.com?tools=nanoscrape/impressum-extractor`

Example prompt: "Get the register number, VAT id and managing directors for bosch.de and wienenergie.at."
